# S1.1c-3 lane B2: the classification list for the markers commit (design note v2 §2.3, §5).
# One row per rule-like span (the detector of fragment_test.go) and per fence in SPEC.md, SEMANTICS.md, errors.md
# at the lane branch head: <file>:<line> TAB span|fence TAB <the marker it needs> TAB <the span as quoted>.
# Markers: cep:<kind> (parses as written), cep-meta:<kind> (parses once its placeholders bind), cep-invalid:<kind>
# (listed in tools/allowlists/fragments.json at its stage), text (a notation token survives binding), fix (a §5
# correction; the span is red until corrected), none (an exempt keyword-only mention). A fence row names its tag.
# Classes from R-F3 (testdata/fragments/research-spans.jsonl) where the span is R-F3s; computed by parseFragment otherwise.
